title: Jump Stands
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard covers requirements for jump stands used in gymnastics.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Wrought aluminium alloys, drawn tube for general engineering purposes
Gymnasium Equipment, Part I: General Requirements

marking_requirements: 5.1 The jump stands shall be prominently marked with the
manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark.
